title: Meeting time calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the two wavefronts to meet as 0.75 s.

title: Distance traveled by M
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total distance traveled by mass element M from 0 s to 1.5 s as 12 m.

title: Wave period determination
description: Important: Correctly determines the wave period (T = 1 s) from the given speed and wavelength inferred from the figure.

title: Amplitude at M
description: Important: Recognizes point M is an antinode due to zero path difference, leading to a resultant amplitude of 4 m.

title: Start time for M
description: Important: Identifies that point M begins vibrating at the moment the waves meet (t = 0.75 s).

title: Distance calculation logic
description: Important: Applies the correct relationship (s = 4A * (Δt / T)) for distance traveled in harmonic motion over a non-integer number of half-periods.

title: Wavefront motion setup
description: Optional: Sets up correct equations of motion for the two wavefronts from their initial positions.

title: Sign error in wave speed
description: Pitfall: Assigns incorrect signs to the wave velocities for the left- and right-propagating waves.

title: Path difference mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates the path difference from M to the two sources, leading to a wrong interference condition.
